title: Capricorn: what to know
description: The essentials of Capricorn in a few screens: strengths, challenges, love and work.

pages.title: Capricorn: the basics
pages.text: Approximate dates: Dec 22 - Jan 19. Earth element, cardinal quality, ruled by Saturn.

pages.title: Discipline
pages.text: Capricorn has the focus, patience and responsibility to go far.

pages.title: Rigidity
pages.text: Demanding too much of yourself and others is tiring. Making time to rest is productive too.

pages.title: Commitment
pages.text: Takes the person they choose seriously. Shows love with consistency and long-term plans.

pages.title: The one who builds
pages.text: Organized and ambitious, grows in careers that reward results and persistence.
